title: Delegate rate now open at The St. Regis Mumbai for Global Fragrance Summit 2027
summary: Delegates attending the International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) Global Fragrance Summit 2027 in person can now book a room at The St. Regis Mumbai, the Summit venue, at a preferential rate. Rooms at the delegate rate are limited.

extraction.key_fact: IFRA 글로벌 향료 서밋 참가자를 위한 행사장 호텔 우대 요금 예약이 열렸다.
